aboutShort: I am a Senior ML & Systems Engineer with 5+ years of experience owning search, retrieval, agentic AI, and distributed data infrastructure from architecture through production incidents.

At eParts Services, I lead search relevance, RAG, and LLM agent architecture for Peregrin—a multi-tenant industrial procurement platform serving millions of catalog SKUs. Before graduate school at Carnegie Mellon University (MSE, 3.87 GPA), I spent three years at BlackRock engineering Cassandra and Hadoop data platforms for Aladdin.
aboutExtended: Most ML failures in production are actually data contract, retrieval, or authorization failures in disguise. A tool-calling agent is only as trustworthy as its permission boundary and golden evaluation loop; a search ranking function only works if the upstream ingestion pipeline doesn't silently drop documents during bulk backpressure.

My work spans the full vertical slice required to make applied AI reliable in enterprise software: designing partitioned PostgreSQL and Snowflake schemas, running Debezium + Kafka CDC pipelines on Kubernetes, tuning Elasticsearch analyzers for messy industrial part numbers, and shipping human-in-the-loop MCP and Azure AI Foundry agents with strict relationship-based access control (ReBAC).

Outside of production systems, I mentored graduate students at Carnegie Mellon as a Teaching Assistant for Prompt Engineering and Software Requirements Engineering, and led the Adrich capstone engineering studio scaling embedded IoT telemetry 250x.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Retrieval & data integrity precede model complexity
engineeringPrinciples.body: Fixing 6 silent bulk-indexing defects on a 26M-SKU Elasticsearch cluster and deduplicating 400K noisy attachment rows into 29K canonical PDFs delivered more end-user accuracy than any prompt tweak.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Every agentic write requires a cryptographic & ReBAC boundary
engineeringPrinciples.body: Production LLM tools should never mutate tenant state on raw model output alone. We pair Permit relationship-based access control with signed 5-minute HMAC action tokens and explicit user confirmation.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Measure systems with continuous evals and unit economics
engineeringPrinciples.body: Whether cutting Snowflake CDC compute by 95% (48 credits/day to batched micro-drains) or gating chatbot PRs with rubric-judged production trace exports, architecture decisions must report back in dollars, milliseconds, and recall.

experience.product: Peregrin — Multi-Tenant Industrial Procurement & Catalog SaaS
experience.role: Senior ML Engineer (Search, RAG & Agentic AI Lead)
experience.summary: Own search relevance, production RAG, LLM agent architecture, MCP integrations, and Kafka-to-Snowflake CDC data platforms across a 26M-SKU multi-tenant SaaS ecosystem.

highlights.text: Eliminated silent record loss across a 26M-document Elasticsearch index by root-causing 6 sync defects and rebuilding ingestion with keyset pagination, ~1,000-doc / 5 MB bulk chunks, zero-downtime alias swaps with count verification, 15-minute deltas, and 2x write concurrency. Shipped tiered exact/normalized/prefix/fuzzy ranking for the ~77% of SKUs containing slashes, cutting bucket aggregations from 100,000 to 500.

highlights.domain: Agentic AI Platform & Stateless MCP Server
highlights.text: Shipped Peregrin's production AI assistant on Azure AI Foundry (scoring 25/25 on golden evals) with 42 strict function-calling tools, Permit ReBAC, and signed 5-minute action tokens for human-in-the-loop writes. Built a stateless 36-tool OAuth 2.1 MCP server (156 tests) making Peregrin operable directly from Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code.

highlights.domain: Production RAG & Company Knowledge Layer (eParts Brain)
highlights.text: Made ~35K product spec and installation documents (28 GB) answerable by AI agents at ~98% ingestion success by deduplicating ~400K rows to ~29K unique files in Azure Blob + Azure AI Search. Designed eParts Brain across Granola, Linear, GitHub, and Confluence using Snowflake Cortex Search hybrid retrieval behind a managed MCP server with weekly top-5 evals for ~$15–30/mo.

highlights.domain: CDC Streaming Platform & 95% Snowflake Cost Reduction
highlights.text: Streamed 436 production SQL Server tables into a 493-table Snowflake Bronze layer (cut over 04/2026) via Debezium + Strimzi Kafka on AKS provisioned with Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions. Cut Snowflake ingestion spend ~95% (from ~48 credits/day per-record MERGEs to scheduled batch MERGEs with auto-suspend) and took Siemens live on a 74-table (~2.1M row) zero-pricing-leak data share.

Built the .NET real-time notification service in 3 weeks (Hangfire, Azure SignalR across 3–10 replicas, SendGrid, PostgreSQL), led the KOBA Service Bus pricing microservice and v5 billion-row partitioned schema migration, designed a native transactional-outbox workflow engine at ~$40/mo (avoiding a ~$50K/yr n8n license and 2026 RCE), and directed a 382-class ETIM OCR classification pipeline (95% OCR, 92% class match, 21 ms latency).
